name: google-calendar
author: John P. Giatropoulos
description: Granular Google Calendar widgets — upcoming events, event details, and quick event creation.

widgets.name: GCalUpcoming
widgets.description: Chronological list of upcoming Google Calendar events. Click an event to publish an eventSelected event.

widgets.name: GCalEventDetail
widgets.description: Display full details for a selected Google Calendar event. Listens for eventSelected events.

widgets.name: GCalQuickCreate
widgets.description: Quick-create form for Google Calendar events with title, date, time, and optional location.

widgets.name: GoogleCalendarWidget
widgets.description: View today's agenda, upcoming meetings, and create events via Google Calendar MCP.
